name: a-full-run-records-why-a-day-failed
find:
// the marker has to survive to the card that offers it (#730).
                failDayRegen(day, for: eventID, pipelineError: pipelineError)
replace:
// the marker has to survive to the card that offers it (#730).
                _ = pipelineError
breaks: a day that failed inside the whole week rebuild records no reason at all, so the screen shows nothing about it and Friday's clip shortfall escape hatch, which is reached from the recorded failure, is unreachable for exactly the run that produces most of them (#740, #730, #721)
